package.name: vision_node
package.description: ArUco marker-based vision perception for the moving-platform landing target: aruco_landing_target_node (camera -> LandingTarget) and vision_relative_state_node (LandingTarget -> RLObservation), the deployment/demo counterpart to the relative_state package's ground-truth-based training path. Needs opencv-contrib-python (for cv2.aruco) installed via pip -- see docker/Dockerfile -- since it isn't a rosdep-resolvable package.
